A shot of Mauricio Pochettino, the Tottenham Hotspur manager, on the touchline. He is dressed in a dark suit and is looking intently at the pitch, possibly giving instructions to his players. His focused expression reflects the importance of the match.
A wide shot of Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang placing the ball on the penalty spot. Hugo Lloris is in goal, and players from both teams are lined up outside the penalty area.
A wide shot of the penalty area as the referee blows his whistle for the penalty to be taken.
Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang runs up and strikes the ball low into the bottom left corner of the net. Hugo Lloris dives the wrong way. Arsenal take a 1-0 lead.
A replay of the penalty goal from a wide angle, showing Aubameyang's run-up and strike.
A replay of the goal from behind the net, showing the ball flying past Hugo Lloris.
A close-up shot of the ball hitting the back of the net.
A medium shot of Tottenham manager Mauricio Pochettino on the bench. He is talking to his assistants and looks concerned. The 'BYD' logo is visible on the bench seats.
A medium shot of the Tottenham bench, showing Toby Alderweireld and Lucas Moura. They are watching the game intently.
A close-up shot of Unai Emery watching the game intently from the technical area.
Arsenal manager Unai Emery is seen sitting on the bench, engaged in an animated tactical discussion with his assistant, Juan Carlos Carcedo. They are both gesturing as they talk.
Medium shot of Tottenham manager Mauricio Pochettino standing in the technical area, looking concerned. He is wearing a dark suit and coat. Fans are visible in the background.
Medium shot of Pochettino walking along the touchline, hands in his pockets, looking down at the pitch. He appears to be deep in thought about his team's performance.
Medium shot of Pochettino looking towards the pitch, adjusting his hair. He remains in the technical area, observing the game as play is about to resume.
Medium shot of Pochettino standing still, observing the game. He looks towards the referee and the players as they prepare for the free kick.
Medium shot of Arsenal manager Unai Emery talking to his assistant coach on the bench. He is wearing a dark Arsenal jacket with the Puma logo. He looks focused and is giving instructions.
Medium shot of Unai Emery looking focused and intense as he watches the game from the touchline. He is gesturing with his hands, seemingly urging his players on.

Medium shot of Unai Emery celebrating the goal with his coaching staff and players on the bench. He is punching the air and shouting with joy. The Arsenal fans in the background are also celebrating wildly.
A close-up of Tottenham manager Mauricio Pochettino on the bench, looking concerned and discussing tactics with his assistant.

Close-up of Arsenal manager Unai Emery on the touchline, speaking with substitute Matteo Guendouzi (29). Emery is giving tactical instructions using a small notepad. Guendouzi, with his distinctive long curly hair, listens intently. 'BYD' branding is visible on the stadium fascia behind them.
Arsenal manager Unai Emery celebrates passionately on the touchline, pumping his fists in the air as the crowd roars.
Unai Emery is seen shouting instructions to his players from the technical area.
Unai Emery is seen celebrating again on the touchline, clearly delighted with his team's performance.
Arsenal manager Unai Emery is shown sitting on the bench, looking calm and occasionally smiling as he watches the game unfold. He is wearing a black Arsenal jacket.

A close-up shot of Arsenal manager Unai Emery on the touchline. He gives a double thumbs-up gesture towards his players, then turns and walks back to the dugout to sit down. The dugout seats feature 'BYD' branding. He appears satisfied.

A close-up shot of Unai Emery on the touchline, looking calm and composed as his team nears a significant victory. He is watching the play intently. The background shows the 'BYD' branding on the dugout seats.
